programme.title: E1 - Morel Mushrooms
programme.desc: Each spring sees the start of the morel mushroom season in the Canadian West. Gaetan Dore has been participating in this rush for 'brown gold' for six years. In one day, the gatherer from the Montreal region can pick mushrooms to the value of 500 Canadian dollars.

programme.title: E16 - Maison Daum/Hortillonnages D'amiens
programme.desc: A stroll down rue Jacob, in the Saint-Germain-des-Pres district. Daum is one of France's most daring innovators in the art of glassmaking. Everything you need to know about the dinner jacket belt. In the heart of the Somme, the marshes in Amiens host the annual Garden Festival. Adopt the tutu, the mini-skirt of the moment.

programme.title: E15 - Very Private Visits
programme.desc: A rare behind-the-scenes dive into hidden corners of Paris: the Paris-Vincennes racecourse, the Parc des Princes stadium, the Republican Guard headquarters... Usually inaccessible to the general public, these iconic sites open their doors to Paname.

programme.title: E2 - My Island In Brittany
programme.desc: A new generation of men and women have chosen to live and work on the Ponant islands. We head to Ouessant, Sein and Saint-Riom to meet the people who have opted for this isolated existence on islands that are sometimes difficult to access, and are both challenging and enchanting.

programme.title: E14 - Behind The Scenes At The Liege Opera!
programme.desc: From the costume workshop to the sets and the accessory stockroom, a tour of the Liege Opera where 'Traviata' is performed. Also featuring director Jean-Marie Poire, landscape designer Alexandre Vandiest, Patrick Syen's Bentleys, and soprano Louise Foor.

programme.title: E8 - Rurutu, The Island That Provides
programme.desc: In the Austral Islands, Rurutu deserves its nickname as the pantry of the South Pacific. Agriculture has historically played a major role on the island. Here, food is produced in sufficient quantities to feed local families.

programme.title: E17 - Renoir/Priscilla Royer/Chitose Abe/Aurelie Boyer
programme.desc: In Essoyes, visit the studio home of the painter Pierre-Auguste Renoir. programme.title: E3
programme.desc: Join the search for a Cooper’s hawk who’s taken a dangerous dip in a backyard pool. Catch the hijinks of the centre’s skunks as they try to avoid getting their shots, giving the team a closeup experience with the animals’ stinky natural defences.

programme.title: E1 - Haven of Giants
programme.desc: Lewa Conservancy is working to return elephants to territory from Mt. Kenya to Samburu National Park. They've also created an elephant exclusion zone to try and restore a damaged ecosystem. Radio tracking collars are used for both initiatives to help conservationists better understand the elephants’ needs - and to see if they're returning to their natural corridors.

programme.title: E4 - Vanishing Wilderness
programme.desc: Kenya's growing human population is taking land and resources away from wildlife. The squeeze is creating increasing numbers of conflicts between humans and animals, and is one of the biggest issues in African conservation.

programme.title: E5 - Detour
programme.desc: Travel to the ends of Australia’s shark highways. Find out if Greenly Island in the south is a truck stop for migrating great whites, then search for proof of a genetic connection between northern bull sharks and their cooler-climate cousins.

programme.title: The Ocean's Greatest Feast
programme.desc: Get a front-row seat to the planet’s biggest biomass migration, the annual 1,000-mile sardine run along South Africa’s east coast. See billions of these tiny fish run a gauntlet of hungry predators, including stealthy seals and dive-bombing gannets.

programme.title: E3 - Brown Bear
programme.desc: Revisit the evolutionary journey of brown bears, from ursid ancestors that dominated the ice ages to today’s modern omnivores. Witness their symbiotic relationship with salmon and the surprisingly interconnected ecosystems they thrive in.

programme.title: E3 - So Long and Thanks for All the Fish
programme.desc: Bundle up as an icy October storm complicates the race to the finish line. See Big Boi bounce after a stumble before tragedy hits QuadMom, and cheer as fan fave BoldFace hits her stride despite her clingy kid, Raccoon. But who will wear the crown?

programme.desc: 刑警何遠航（潘粵明 飾）與其徒弟冉方旭（王鶴棣 飾）調查一起涉及徐家父女的神秘失蹤案。1997年，二人在元龍里小區電梯口失蹤，冉方旭最初認定案件為惡意逃債，但2006年，徐父的遺體被意外發現，推翻了這一結論。 近十年後，何遠航的女兒、已成為警察的何曉荷（任敏 飾）發現案件與過往線索的關聯。她與父親聯手，欲在小區拆遷前夕最終揭露真相。
